settings.heading: Do you deliver to my area?
settings.row_content: Available delivery options and charges are shown at checkout. Contact us if you need help before placing an order.

settings.heading: How do I return an item?
settings.row_content: Please contact us with your order number before sending an item back. We can explain eligibility and the next steps. See our Delivery & Returns page for more information.

settings.heading: How do I choose the right food for my pet?
settings.row_content: Your pet's age, size, and individual needs matter. Check the product information and feeding guide. For special diets or health concerns, ask your veterinarian before changing food.

settings.heading: How can I get help with an order?
settings.row_content: Send us a message through our Contact page and include your order number if you have one.
